statement: Hurricane Trudy makes landfall in Mexico at hurricane intensity, with maximum sustained winds of at least 64 knots, between 2026-10-17 and 2026-10-24.
resolution: TRUE if a National Hurricane Center advisory or tropical cyclone update issued between 2026-10-17 and 2026-10-24 reports the center of Trudy making landfall in Mexico with maximum sustained winds of 64 knots or more; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: The center of Trudy does not cross the Mexican coastline with maximum sustained winds of 64 knots or more at any time between 2026-10-17 and 2026-10-24.

statement: At least one FOMC voting member dissents from the federal funds rate decision announced on 2026-10-28 at the close of the scheduled 2026-10-27 to 2026-10-28 meeting.
resolution: TRUE if the FOMC statement published on federalreserve.gov on 2026-10-28 names at least one member voting against the policy action; FALSE if the recorded vote is unanimous.
failure_condition: Every FOMC voting member votes in favor of the policy action announced on 2026-10-28.

statement: At least one merchant vessel is hit by a projectile, drone, mine, or explosive, or is seized, in the Strait of Hormuz, Gulf of Oman, or Persian Gulf between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-08.
resolution: TRUE if UKMTO or JMIC reports a merchant vessel hit by a projectile, drone, mine, or explosive, or seized, in the Strait of Hormuz, Gulf of Oman, or Persian Gulf between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-08; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: No merchant vessel is hit by a weapon or seized in the Strait of Hormuz, Gulf of Oman, or Persian Gulf between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-08.

statement: Russia launches at least 700 drones and missiles combined at Ukraine in a single overnight attack between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-15.
resolution: TRUE if a Ukrainian Air Force daily summary, as carried by Reuters, AP, or Kyiv Independent, counts at least 700 drones and missiles launched in one overnight attack dated between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-15; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: No single overnight Russian attack on Ukraine between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-15 involves 700 or more drones and missiles combined.

statement: The Nasdaq Composite closes at or below 23,526.03, ten percent under the reference level, on at least one trading day between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-30. Reference: 26,140.03 on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if FRED series NASDAQCOM shows a daily close at or below 23,526.03 for any date between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-30 inclusive; FALSE otherwise. Reference: 26,140.03 on the packet date.
failure_condition: The Nasdaq Composite closes above 23,526.03 on every trading day from 2026-10-19 through 2026-11-30.

statement: The WTI crude oil price at Cushing is at or above 110.00 dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-30. Reference: 99.02 dollars per barrel on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if FRED series DCOILWTICO shows a daily value at or above 110.00 for any date between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-30 inclusive; FALSE otherwise. Reference: 99.02 dollars per barrel on the packet date.
failure_condition: The WTI crude oil price at Cushing stays below 110.00 dollars per barrel on every trading day from 2026-10-19 through 2026-11-30.

statement: Republican Senator Roger Marshall loses the 2026-11-03 Kansas US Senate general election.
resolution: TRUE if certified 2026-11-03 Kansas US Senate general election results published by the Kansas Secretary of State show a candidate other than Roger Marshall receiving the most votes; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: Roger Marshall receives the most votes in the 2026-11-03 Kansas US Senate general election.

statement: CISA adds at least one Drupal vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a date-added value between 2026-10-19 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV JSON feed contains at least one entry with vendorProject Drupal and dateAdded between 2026-10-19 and 2026-12-31 inclusive; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: No Drupal vulnerability is added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-10-19 and 2026-12-31.

statement: Federal criminal charges naming US Representative Ilhan Omar as a defendant become public between 2026-10-19 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if a federal indictment, information, or criminal complaint naming Ilhan Omar as a defendant appears unsealed on a federal court docket in PACER or CourtListener between 2026-10-19 and 2026-12-31; FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: No federal charging document naming Ilhan Omar as a defendant is publicly filed or unsealed between 2026-10-19 and 2026-12-31.

statement: A Democrat is elected Speaker of the US House at the opening of the 120th Congress, in a floor vote held between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-15, following the 2026-11-03 midterm elections.
resolution: TRUE if the House Clerk roll call electing the 120th Congress Speaker, held between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-15, elects a Democrat; FALSE if a non-Democrat or nobody is elected in that window.
failure_condition: The Speaker elected between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-15 is not a Democrat, or no Speaker is elected in that window.
